Chair asked again for public comment or comment from commissioners/staff; none offered.

votes.motion: Authorize development and advertising of a comprehensive procurement combining sewer pump station operations, maintenance, emergency services, and construction/capital repair work into a single multi-year contract, and recommend a warrant article authorizing the town to enter such a contract at the November 17, 2026 special town meeting.

budget_items.topic: Sewer pump station O&M / construction contract procurement
budget_items.what_was_said: The commission moved to authorize advertising a comprehensive, combined multi-year contract for pump station operations, maintenance, emergency services and capital repair, to go before the November 17, 2026 special town meeting as a warrant article. No fiscal impact was noted as attaching to the commission's own vote.

budget_items.topic: Privilege fee assessment, 786-796 Mass Ave (Old Stone Farm)
budget_items.what_was_said: The property was assessed a privilege fee tied to two betterments; the amount was described and the property owners had already paid by check, with paperwork to go to the treasurer.
This property was assessed its privilege fee; the amount was stated and there was no dispute from the owners.
Part of the pending procurement work overlaps with an existing CTE-related contract that was due to expire; an extension was obtained to November 25th to allow more time to finish the work.

decisions.decision: Corrected the previously posted September 22 meeting date to September 29 at 6pm via Zoom.
Confirmed the 786-796 Mass Ave and 67 Pratt Street privilege-fee properties are fully paid up and hooked up, closing out that item.
Commission agreed to keep its connection/privilege fee rate as-is (status quo) after hearing from town counsel.

minutes.headline: Sewer Commission voted to seek a combined multi-year pump station O&M/construction contract for Nov. town meeting
minutes.summary: The Sewer Commission approved minutes, voted to pursue a comprehensive multi-year contract combining pump station operations, maintenance and capital repair work, to be recommended as a warrant article for the November 17, 2026 special town meeting. It also closed out privilege fee assessments on two properties, kept its fee rate unchanged after input from town counsel, and recognized two commissioners for long service on the commission's 20th anniversary.
